claimBoundary: UI-only assessment on the real running app with a synthetic audit fixture and local fixture login. Completeness is not UX conformance. No governance, auth/writer correctness, human comprehension, accessibility certification, theme/accent coverage, R1/R2 exit or production claim.

runner.note: Independent check after exit: no listener on 3033 (23 TIME_WAIT sockets only), git status shows tsconfig.json and next-env.d.ts unchanged, hashes equal the pre-run pins.

boundary.authBootstrap: Auth bootstrap used the existing loginAs helper (APIRequestContext), which context routing cannot observe; browser-level auth GETs are in the traffic counts.
boundary.note: The one preload-blocked network attempt is a Node server-process connection to registry.npmjs.org logged during Next startup, before the browser test (isolation log); the seven browser-side blocked requests were all to fonts.googleapis.com, aborted by the context route.

languageSwitching.basis: 12/12 rows: html lang matches, owned labels visible, expected disclosure fragments present with no wrong-profile text, real visible toggle used, literal goal/criterion/title preserved in 3/3 selected switches.

keyboard.basis: Toggle, record button, Goal, Criterion 1 and Build reached by real Tab at all 3 viewports; Enter and Space toggled language; Enter opened the panel; Shift+Tab/Tab round trip returned to Build; Tab moved away from and back to Build after validation; no trap. Findings UXF-01..03.

geometry.basis: 12/12 rows: no document or panel horizontal overflow, 0 controls outside the viewport, 0 overlaps, disclosure above Build in DOM and position and not clipped.

preEffectRefusal.basis: 6/6 agent-simulated decisions read the disclosure, left the panel without Build and caused 0 write attempts; empty-goal prevalidation produced the localized actionable message and 0 write attempts.

findings.evidence: Tab stops needed from page start to the selected record export button: desktop 44, tablet 44, mobile 47; Build button at stop 55, 55, 58. No skip link was observed in the sequence (first stops are header and sidebar items).
findings.sourceLocator: dashboard shell sidebar navigation (exact component not inspected by this worker)
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Add a skip-to-main-content link or collapse sidebar groups from the tab order.

findings.evidence: For every text input, select and textarea in the export panel (the seven field stops at each viewport: stops 48-54 desktop and tablet, 51-57 mobile) the computed focused outline was none 0px and box-shadow none, identical to the blurred state. The classes use outline-none with focus:border-indigo-500; border-color change was not measured and no screenshot shows a focused field, so whether a visible border-only indicator exists is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Add a focus-visible ring (DESIGN.md section 6) and re-measure with border/background included.

findings.evidence: The language toggle focused outline computed as auto 0px (width zero) at the toggle stop on all three viewports (stop 1 desktop and tablet, stop 3 mobile); no screenshot was taken with the toggle focused, so visibility is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Give the toggle an explicit focus-visible ring.

findings.evidence: All 12 rows contain a primary target below 44px height. Desktop/tablet: language toggle 34, record export button 30, Add criterion 24, Criterion 1 field 34, Title field 38. Mobile (390): toggle, record button and Add criterion measure 44, but Criterion 1 field is 34 and Title field 38.
findings.sourceLocator: src/lib/i18n.tsx LanguageToggle; work-transfer page record button; HtmlJobControls.tsx Add criterion and Criterion input; EXTENSIONS/CVF_v1.6_AGENT_PLATFORM/cvf-web/src/components/ArtifactExportPanel.tsx fields
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Apply min-h-11 to those controls at touch widths.

findings.evidence: Add criterion renders as plain unstyled text 92x24 (EN) on desktop and tablet (see desktop-keyboard-build-validation screenshot); nothing shows it is a button.
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Reuse the existing secondary button style.

findings.evidence: In Vietnamese the export panel still shows the English pill Candidate (and the acronym HTML) in 6 of 6 selected-vi and generic-vi rows (possiblyUntranslated lists Candidate).

The inViewportAtRead flag was false at most stops because global CSS sets scroll-behavior smooth (globals.css line 185) and focus was read immediately after the key press, mid-scroll. The 86 off-screen flags are a measurement-timing artifact and are not reported as a finding.
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Wait for scroll end before reading focus geometry in a later admission.

findings.evidence: The empty-goal validation text was visible in the DOM (isVisible true, exact localized text), but the keyboard screenshots were taken mid-scroll and do not show it; on-screen visibility is unverified.
findings.suggestedBoundedFix: Scroll the message into view before the screenshot.
